events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, bringing together hundreds of thousands for "3 Days of Peace & Music".

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: 57 years since the original Woodstock. What's your favourite memory or performance from the iconic festival?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on this day in 1977, he would have been 91.

angles.name: King of Rock 'n' Roll
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley today. What's your go-to track from The King?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The iconic Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG
angles.copy: Bonehead's Bank Holiday? Nah, it's Liam Gallagher's 54th birthday! What's your favourite Oasis or solo track from the man himself?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the 1962 premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite thing about 007?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86

angles.name: Imagine...

events.title: John Cleese turns 87

angles.name: And now for something completely different...
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on this day in 1991, he would have been 80.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who we lost on this day in 1991. His music and legend live on.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965, marking a significant artistic progression.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Rewind
angles.copy: 51 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Which track from this iconic album is still on your playlist?
